import time

def throw_catch_loop():
    start = time.perf_counter_ns()
    try:
        raise RuntimeError("x")
    except RuntimeError:
        pass
    return time.perf_counter_ns() - start

def new_exception_loop():
    start = time.perf_counter_ns()
    RuntimeError("x")
    return time.perf_counter_ns() - start

def new_object_loop():
    start = time.perf_counter_ns()
    object()
    return time.perf_counter_ns() - start

def new_no_stack_exception_loop():
    start = time.perf_counter_ns()
    err = RuntimeError("x")
    err.with_traceback(None)
    return time.perf_counter_ns() - start

import time
